name: hcportal_getAppVersionUsage
description: HC Admin Tools > Version email (E19.F3.S3): every app build people are on now (HC6.AppVersionUsers: each person once, at the highest build among their phones signed in within @days), with iPhone and Android counts, newest first. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; the caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanManageNewsflash = 1. Idempotency: read-only.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Last sign-in within this many days (1..3650, default 90).

rowsets.name: Refusal
rowsets.description: { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } when auth or the CanManageNewsflash platform-admin gate fails.

rowsets.name: Versions
rowsets.description: One row per build, newest first.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
